title: GraphSmith release signature (register Lane D — air-gapped verification)
description: A detached maintainer signature over the release manifest, delivered out-of-band. Lets an air-gapped site verify signature -> manifest -> files with no network and no trust in the distributing registry. Extends the T (trust-root) profile from 'manifest matches disk' to 'manifest is authentic without a network'. Frozen Wave 0 (v0.3.0).

signer.description: Maintainer key identifier. Trust of this key is verifier policy (out-of-band key distribution), not a GraphSmith guarantee.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the release manifest this signature covers.

delivery.description: The signature is delivered separately from the registry it authenticates — the whole point of air-gapped trust.
